bio.short: I lead distributed design teams and build systems that keep quality consistent at speed. At Datameer I led design across Germany and New York; at Ninox I led five people and built the team's development mechanisms. At Bibel TV I combined multi-platform design, AI-supported workflows and real-code prototypes.
bio.long:
At Datameer I led design across Germany and New York for a data-dense enterprise product. I coordinated quality across time zones and helped move design from execution into product strategy. At Ninox I later led five people across product design and UX writing. I built the leveling framework and growth practices, hired two and promoted two.

At Bibel TV I worked hands-on across iOS, Android, web and connected TV. I prototyped against production APIs and created reusable systems that help product work stay coherent across platforms. An external engineering agency worked from the running prototype code. I also used AI in research synthesis and in shipped internal workflows.

My strongest contribution is turning design quality into an operating system: clear standards, reusable components, direct feedback and evidence from product use. That record transfers to adjoe's distributed environment, while the portfolio remains honest about its stronger product and systems focus.

context.emphasis: Lead with distributed team leadership, quality systems and current multi-platform production work. Use AI practice as an accelerant, not the identity of the application.
